policy: Native Standard baseline; consider at most two alternatives from its native pool within one native point of the top ranked candidate. Require no decrease in minimum/mean strong followups after removing the strongest remaining choice, hero eligible-role count, or capped native disable/save/reach/siege/waveclear coverage. Require composition, threat, synergy, doctrine and timing components within 0.5 native points of baseline. Final own pick remains unchanged. Compare six native continuation simulations (two future enemy openings times three presets) without enemy hidden role locks or plans. Alternatives must not reduce training wins, mean NW or worst NW; sample the baseline and eligible alternatives using native-score temperature 1.75. This is a hypothesis, not a professional-player model or win guarantee.
optimization: Reuse the production optimizer harness: all 64 own strategies against three presets, at most 100 native ordered-item candidates total, then strategy retuning. Fixed work budget with frozen time, not live timing.
holdout: Reuse case-specific paired streams and native enemy strategy/role/default-order variants; exclude exact optimizer training profiles. Both complete policies are played in the simulator, not a diluted mixture. No parameter changes after outcomes are inspected.
acceptance: 10000 stratified paired whole-draft bootstrap resamples. Success lower one-sided 95% bound >= -0.005; severe-loss upper bound <= +0.005; first-pick and first-ban entropy point changes nonnegative, entropy sum positive with lower bound >=0. Severe loss means lose and signed NW <-20000. Passing permits a separate integration test only, not automatic production enablement.
production: Unchanged pending evidence and live-flow validation. No scheduler or recurring AI work.
